paragraphs.text: The Muraytt Mountains' is a range of peaks somewhere in Dominaria .

The Muraytt Mountains lie south of a great icy plain, east of the endless ocean, and north of inhabited swamps and forests. The mountains feature the abandoned city of Binyen , once guarded by a Granite Gargoyle , and the cave of a Shivan Dragon .

Although its exact location is somewhat vague, the Muraytts must lie in the vicinity of Terisiare somewhere, as the gargoyle guardian of Binyat remembers ornithopters from the period of the Brothers' War .
